# Coder-B Apps

> Official product information, support documentation, and privacy policies for apps made by Coder-B.

## Featured app

- [Gentle Bye](https://coder-b.github.io/App/GentleBye/): An iPhone and iPad kids video timer that helps parents select public YouTube videos, set a total viewing-time limit, and guide a calm transition when the session ends.
- [Gentle Bye support](https://coder-b.github.io/App/GentleBye/support.html): Setup instructions, product behavior, frequently asked questions, and troubleshooting.
- [Gentle Bye privacy policy](https://coder-b.github.io/App/GentleBye/privacy.html): Data collection, providers, retention, choices, and deletion requests.

## Important facts about Gentle Bye

- Parents select every video and arrange the queue.
- A session uses one total viewing-time limit.
- Gentle reminders begin during the final 90 seconds.
- The app does not require a name, email address, or password.
- Search uses YouTube's strict SafeSearch setting, but parents should review every video.
- Gentle Bye is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube or Google.

## Afterlook

- [Afterlook](https://coder-b.github.io/App/Roomery/): An iPhone app that turns room photos into AI renovation previews, estimates, product ideas, and shareable before-and-after proposals.
- [Download Afterlook](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/afterlook/id6779862210): Official App Store listing.
- [Afterlook support](https://coder-b.github.io/App/Roomery/support.html): Features, setup instructions, FAQs, and troubleshooting.
- [Afterlook privacy policy](https://coder-b.github.io/App/Roomery/privacy.html): Photo processing, storage, sharing, retention, and deletion information.
- [Real Afterlook example — Living room](https://renoai.freewill.website/share/0bd9d5ec-afd8-4a40-8b27-b7bd7322825e): A public before-and-after project showing applied floor and wall changes with an itemized renovation estimate.

### Important facts about Afterlook

- Users can apply materials, colors, and finishes to selected areas of a room photo.
- Multiple changes can be layered and reverted.
- Estimates can include quantities, unit prices, contingency, labor, permits, and other costs.
- Shared project links open in a browser; recipients do not need the app.
- Afterlook is available for iPhone and requires iOS 18.6 or later.
